raw/Clay - company-research.md.title: Clay
raw/Clay - company-research.md.summary: Clay is a GTM data and agentic-automation platform that helps GTM teams automate prospecting, enrichment, scoring, and outreach. It combines data from over 200 providers with AI research agents like Claygent and orchestration tools. The company operates on a credit-based usage pricing model and has secured significant funding rounds.

key_points.point: Combines 1st/3rd-party data from 200+ providers, AI research agents (Claygent), and orchestration.
Business Model is self-serve + enterprise SaaS with credit-based usage pricing.
Core modules include Data infrastructure, Agents (Claygents), and Orchestration.
Clay's moat includes an aggregator moat from 200+ vendors and a category-creation community moat.
Strategic focus is to become the orchestration layer/operating system for GTM.
Key roles include GTM Engineer and Enterprise Growth Strategist.

raw/ClickHouse - company-research.md.title: ClickHouse
raw/ClickHouse - company-research.md.summary: ClickHouse is a leading open-source, column-oriented OLAP database used for real-time analytics at petabyte scale. It is expanding its focus to become a leading database for AI, offering a commercial cloud service alongside its open-source core. The company recently secured Series D funding and has a strong customer base including Meta and Anthropic.

key_points.point: It is an open-source, column-oriented OLAP database for real-time analytics.
Its business model combines an open-source core with a commercial ClickHouse Cloud offering usage/consumption-based pricing.
The company recently raised Series D funding of $400M at a ~$15B valuation.
Core products include ClickHouse (OSS), ClickHouse Cloud, ClickStack (observability), and ClickPipes.
Its moat includes extreme query speed, open-source adoption, and cost-efficiency compared to warehouses.
The strategic focus is to become the default database layer for AI/agentic apps and observability.
The company is hiring heavily in engineering and is building out RevOps/commercial systems.

raw/David AI - company-research.md.title: David AI
raw/David AI - company-research.md.summary: David AI positions itself as the first audio data research lab, building the data layer required by frontier AI teams for speech, voice-agent, and multimodal AI. The company operates as a B2B audio data infrastructure provider, scaling a data factory rather than just selling static datasets. Its core process involves starting with a model capability hypothesis and productionizing the necessary audio data.

key_points.point: It is positioned as the first audio data research lab, not a generic labeling vendor.
The business model is B2B audio data infrastructure, involving dataset licensing and custom development.
Key products include Converse (two-speaker conversations) and Atlas (multilingual audio dataset).
The company's moat includes audio-native specialization and a research-driven workflow.
The company is scaling its data production engine alongside its technical platform.
Operations roles focus on building and scaling data pipelines, contributor supply, and quality control.
Product Ops owns data products from prototype to scale, defining workflows and monitoring throughput.
Data/Marketplace Ops builds contributor networks and runs channel experiments to improve retention.
GTM Engineering adjacent roles involve using funnel analytics and A/B testing for supply-side contributor acquisition.

concepts.name: Research-Driven Workflow
concepts.why: David AI designs datasets around desired model capabilities and evaluates model impact, moving beyond simple data cleaning.

concepts.name: Data Pipeline Scaling
concepts.why: The company needs to turn bespoke audio data experiments into reliable, high-volume production systems.

concepts.name: Data Product Ownership
concepts.why: Product Ops is responsible for owning data products from prototype through to scale.

concepts.name: Contributor Network Management

raw/Decagon - company-research.md.title: Decagon
raw/Decagon - company-research.md.summary: Decagon is positioning itself as an enterprise "AI concierge" platform for customer experience, moving beyond being just a chatbot vendor. Its product thesis centers on creating continuously improving AI agents through a comprehensive operating loop involving iteration, governance, and measurable outcomes. The company is focused on winning large enterprise customers by building reliable agent infrastructure.

key_points.point: Decagon builds enterprise AI agents for customer experience across voice, chat, email, SMS, and other channels.
The company's product thesis is that AI agents should act like continuously improving teammates, not static SaaS configurations.
Key product modules include AOPs, Duet, Duet Autopilot, and Watchtower for agent lifecycle management.
The company is focused on scaling from high-touch enterprise wins to a repeatable, globally deployable platform.
The company has 119 open roles across various departments.
Hiring is focused on deepening voice and agent infrastructure.
Leadership includes Co-founder & CEO Jesse Zhang and Co-founder & President Ashwin Sreenivas.
The company values include Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner's Mindset, and The Polymath Principle.
Operations roles are critical for building repeatable systems across deployment, pricing, and GTM execution.
International expansion is occurring in locations like London, Toronto, and Australia.

concepts.name: AI Concierge Platform
concepts.why: This concept defines Decagon's strategic positioning as an advanced, holistic customer experience solution rather than just a simple chatbot.

concepts.name: Agent Operating Procedures
concepts.why: AOPs are central to Decagon's product, allowing teams to define and iterate agent behavior using natural language instructions.

concepts.name: Continuous Improvement Loop
concepts.why: This loop, powered by Duet and Autopilot, allows production signals to drive validated, self-improving agent updates.

concepts.name: Enterprise Governance
concepts.why: Decagon emphasizes governance through simulations, versioning, and human approval to ensure enterprise trust and compliance.

concepts.name: Polymath Principle
concepts.why: This principle suggests a good fit for candidates who can connect analytics, GTM, product, customer operations, and AI workflows.

concepts.name: Agent Infrastructure
concepts.why: Decagon is actively hiring roles to deepen its voice and agent infrastructure capabilities.

concepts.name: Enterprise GTM

raw/Harvey AI - company-research.md.title: Harvey AI
raw/Harvey AI - company-research.md.summary: Harvey AI provides domain-specific, professional-class AI, acting as an operating system for legal and professional services. The company operates on a B2B enterprise SaaS model, serving major law firms and corporate in-house teams globally. It has achieved significant funding and valuation, positioning itself as a category leader in legal AI.

raw/Sierra - company-research.md.title: Sierra
raw/Sierra - company-research.md.summary: Sierra provides enterprise conversational AI agents deployed across multiple channels to resolve customer issues and drive revenue. Their business model utilizes outcome-based pricing, aligning vendor incentives with achieved customer outcomes. The company is rapidly scaling, focusing on expanding into internal enterprise agents and regulated verticals.

key_points.point: Deploys conversational AI agents across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and ChatGPT.
Uses a B2B SaaS model with outcome-based pricing, paying for resolved outcomes.
Core modules include Agent Studio, Ghostwriter, and Horizon for long-horizon planning.
The company's moat includes outcome-based pricing alignment and a full agent lifecycle platform.
Strategic focus is to become the global standard for AI-powered CX and expand to internal agents.
Bret Taylor is the Co-founder & CEO and Chair of OpenAI's board.

raw/Surge AI - company-research.md.title: Surge AI
raw/Surge AI - company-research.md.summary: Surge AI is a human-data company focused on providing intelligence for frontier AI, offering services like RLHF and data labeling. It operates on a B2B model, providing bespoke programs and off-the-shelf frontier data and RL environments, and is entirely bootstrapped.

key_points.point: Provides RLHF/data labeling, RL environments, and an elite expert workforce to train LLMs.
Its business model includes B2B services and off-the-shelf frontier data and RL environments.
The company has customers including Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Meta, and Microsoft.
Core products include an Expert Workforce, OTS frontier data, evaluations/benchmarks, and a platform for oversight.
Its moat is built on focusing on complex, agentic, expert-level data and proprietary talent-matching.
The company's strategic focus is to scale RL environments and evaluations as models become agentic.
Edwin Chen is the Founder & CEO, known for advocating quality-over-scale and lean org design.
